_meta.description: CourseMind evaluation dataset (Phase 10). Exercises the real backend: services.answer_question() and services.summarize_document(), which in turn use the real CrewAI Agent, RAG Retrieval Tool, ChromaDB, and OpenAI API. No mocked pipeline except the single dedicated failure_safety case.

document_aliases.primary: Resolved at runtime to the filename of the PDF passed via --pdf (the real Hebrew JavaScript course PDF used throughout development). Its document_id is that filename, matching ingestion's own convention.
document_aliases.secondary: A small synthetic English document about the Roman Empire, built directly in run_evals.py (no PDF file) so the isolation/English cases are fully portable and never depend on a private user file.

_meta.ground_truth_note: expected_source_pages / expected_total_pages / expected_total_chunks were determined by directly inspecting the reference PDF's real indexed content (via ingestion.vectorstore.get_document_chunks) BEFORE writing this dataset -- not by running the eval and copying its output. Re-running against a different PDF via --pdf will legitimately fail these content-specific checks; that is expected, not a bug -- see README.
_meta.case_types: qa (calls services.answer_question), summary (calls services.summarize_document once, shared by all summary-type cases), failure_safety (mocks a RAG failure and checks the system distinguishes it from normal no-evidence)

test_cases.question: When did the Roman Empire fall?
test_cases.notes: Same question as EVAL-008, now correctly scoped to the secondary document where the answer actually lives -- demonstrates isolation is about scoping, not about the question being unanswerable in general.

test_cases.question: When was the Roman Empire founded?
test_cases.notes: A second, distinct English question against the secondary document (not a duplicate of EVAL-009).
Checks general/early coverage: fundamentals, variables, and functions should all be represented. Calibrated to the specific 21-page/27-chunk reference PDF.

Objects is a LATE topic: its 'נושא אובייקטים' heading is on page 19 of 21 (verified by inspecting the indexed chunks directly). Its presence in the summary proves the map-reduce pipeline covered the end of the document, not just the first few pages. Shares EVAL-011's single summarize_document() call -- no extra API cost.
